question: Victor bought several boxes of books at a yard sale and ended up with twenty-four books total. If each box had three books, how many boxes did he buy?
Sam had eleven friends over for his birthday party. Later three of his friends had to go home. How many friends were left?
Will was drawing super heroes on a sheet of scrap paper. He drew two heroes on the front and seven heroes on the back. How many heroes did he draw total?
Each table in a break room can seat eight people. If the break room has four tables, how many people can sit in there?
Adam could fit nine action figures on each shelf in his room. His room has three shelves. How many action figures total could his shelves hold?
Ned mowed his lawn six times in the spring and five times in the summer. How many times did he mow total?
Billy was making ice using ice trays. Each tray held nine ice cubes. If he had eight trays, how many cubes could he make?
Frank had forty-two pieces of candy. If he put them into bags with seven pieces in each bag, how many bags would he have?
For Gwen's birthday she received five dollars. If she spent three dollars. How much money did she still have?
Emily was helping her mom pick apples from the tree in their front yard. Together they picked fourteen totals. If six of the apples weren't ripe yet, how many good apples did they pick?
Oliver bought eight boxes of candy. Later he bought six more boxes. How many boxes did he have totaled?
Tiffany was collecting cans for recycling. On Monday she had four bags of cans. The next day she found eight more bags worth. How many bags did she have totaled?
Lana's mom was buying extra school supplies for her and her siblings. If she bought three packs of glue sticks with seven glue sticks in each pack, how many did she get total?
Maria was placing her spare change into stacks. Each stack had three coins. If she had five stacks, how many coins did she have?
A chef used five potatoes to make fries for the lunch crowd. Later he used another two potatoes for the dinner crowd. How many potatoes did he use total?
Jerry was playing the ring toss at the carnival. All together he used forty-eight rings. If each game you get six rings, how many games did he play?
Tom read three chapters of a book. If each chapter was eight pages, how many pages did he read?
Vanessa bought twelve old CDs at a garage sale. If seven of the CDs were scratched up, how many good CDs did she buy?
Olivia was collecting cans for recycling. She had four bags with five cans inside each bag. How many cans did she have?
Will had twenty-eight bottles of water. If he drank seven each day, how many days would they last him?
Larry's Lawn Care charges nine bucks to trim a hedge. If Henry has three hedges, how much money would he spend?
John was drawing super heroes one sheet of scrap paper. He drew fifteen pictures total. If he drew nine on the back. How many heroes did he draw on the front?
Paul was reading through his favorite book series. Each week he read four different books. How many books would he have read through after five weeks?
A chef had five potatoes to make fries with, but he only used three of them. How many potatoes does he still have?
Amy bought 7 pencils at the school store, but she already had 3 pencils. How many pencils does she have totaled?
